description: Declared ingest clients and their routes (plan 06 section 3). `mise run bootstrap:ingest-clients` renders this file to infra/bootstrap/ingest-clients.sql, which is idempotent and is applied to CORE by an operator (docs/processor.md section 10). A route's `source` is the CORE sources.id; its `producer` is the producer the shared-R2 collector names in its terminal, collector-<collector id>, where the collector id is the terminal's own source id (COLLECTOR_SOURCE_IDS in packages/application/src/collection/descriptors.ts maps it to the CORE id). Producers are created here because they do not exist before U09. No credential: the Processor's client is used in process only and has no HTTP token.
